class.name: SteamLeaderboardSubmission
class.brief_description: An accepted score receipt and its optional replay outcome.

method.name: get_replay_state
method.description: Outcome of attaching the requested replay. Check this even when the result reports an attachment failure.

method.name: get_upload
method.description: Returns the native client upload receipt. A publisher submission can acknowledge the score without a native rank or change receipt, in which case this returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_submitted_score
method.description: Returns the signed score sent in the acknowledged submission.

members.member: Outcome of attaching the requested replay. Check this even when the result reports an attachment failure.
Native client receipt when available, including if a subsequent replay attachment failed. Publisher acknowledgments can leave this null.
Signed score submitted to Steam. Check [member upload] for any native rank or change information.

constants.constant: The caller did not request a replay.
Steam accepted the score, then attachment failed or was cancelled locally.
